mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, session_title, user_id, source, last_message, last_message_time, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM herb_ai_chat_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT session_id, session_title, last_message, last_message_time, source, create_time FROM herb_ai_chat_session
ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_time, create_time) DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE herb_ai_chat_session SET last_message = #{lastMessage}, last_message_time = #{lastMessageTime}, update_time = #{lastMessageTime} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE herb_ai_chat_session SET status = 'deleted', deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
